name: window
title: App window (queue)
shows: A product window: window dots, a breadcrumb with the app's real icon, search; a sidebar with counts; a list of conversations with people, subjects, status and age. The assistant takes each open row: Working, then Replied.
place: at-corner 24 to 40px in, cut by the right and bottom edges (.stage--fade-br), or in a .fit (--fit-max its width) when the whole width should show: the window lays itself out for the width it gets (a container query: rows stack name over subject under 540px, the sidebar goes under 420px), so no column is ever sliced. Pair with cursor laid over its lower-right edge
edit: Rows are HTML (data-tone 1-5 on each avatar). A row whose status reads the open word is worked on. The words are data-open, data-work and data-done on the root (or opts). opts.compact: a 456px window; any narrower wrapper gets the stacked rows by itself, and the breadcrumb gives way before the search box.
loop: about 2.6 s a cycle: two steps of the queue, a row done and the next open row taken; after the last it starts over; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
